title: History Compaction (Fork upsilon): bounded memory, unbounded auditable history
hypothesis: Inactive (former-material) claims accumulated by EXP-517 injection (Ghost #51) can be EVICTED from the live working set with two inertness guarantees: (1) H-INERT -- H_t = HASH(Z+S+W+t) depends only on ACTIVE claims, so eviction leaves H_t bit-identical; (2) OBSERVATIONALLY INERT -- the only all-claims observable eta_CLT is preserved EXACTLY by retaining sufficient statistics (sum/count of evicted norms) instead of the objects. Tiered memory: a bounded SKELETON LINEAGE (deque of last N live snapshots) gives O(1) undo; the EXP-516 provenance DAG keeps every transition hash for unbounded cold history; look-back beyond the window requires DAG replay. Result: constant-time live performance with infinite auditable history. Engine FROZEN.

guarantees.H_inert: evict inactive claims -> live.H == uncompacted H (identity unchanged)
guarantees.obs_inert: eta_CLT via (sum_active + evict_sum)/(n_active + evict_n) == full-population eta_CLT
guarantees.auditable: DAG retains every transition (hashes/witnesses); skeleton retains last N for instant undo

governance_answer: TIERED (not either/or): Skeleton Lineage (hot, O(1) undo within N) + provenance DAG (cold, hashes only, unbounded) + replay to bridge beyond the window -- the EXP-606 hot/cold pattern.
engine_scope: NO engine edits. game/agency/compaction.py uses core (MuState) + game.injection + game.transition_dag. state/operators/confluence/validity FROZEN.
